policy.name: Analysis as a primary scientific contribution
policy.locked_rule: Assign analysis_study only when systematic empirical or theoretical analysis is itself a primary scientific contribution. Routine ablation, robustness testing, parameter sweeps, diagnostic experiments, or ordinary experimental analysis supporting a method do not qualify.
policy.decision_question: Would the paper still make a substantive scientific contribution through its systematic analysis/findings, rather than merely using analysis to validate another primary method?
